===Levels 59–82/91: Double cosmic runes===
''For more information about runecrafting through the Abyss, see [[Abyss/Strategies]]''.<br />

Crafting [[cosmic rune]]s requires completion of the [[Lost City]] quest. Even though cosmic runes become available at level 27, it is not recommended to craft them before level 59 due to much lower profit. Crafting double cosmic runes offers very slow experience, but it can yield good profit at lower levels depending on the rune prices.

The fastest way to craft cosmic runes is through the [[Abyss]]. Alternatively, players can use a [[Fairy rings|fairy ring]] to teleport to [[Zanaris]] and run to the altar, which can be slightly faster for those with low [[Mining]] and/or [[Agility]] levels. Players will need to have level 66 Agility for [[Jutting wall (Zanaris)|the shortcut]], as well as quick access to a fairy ring, such as the [[quest point cape]], [[Construct. cape|Construction cape]] or [[necklace of passage]].

With 70+ Agility and a quest point cape or another form of quick access to a fairy ring, it is possible to get 60 inventories done per hour with high concentration using [[essence pouch]]es. For this method, players should be on the [[Lunar Spellbook]] and have a [[rune pouch]] containing [[Air rune|air]], [[Astral rune|astral]], and [[cosmic rune]]s ready in their bank for casting [[NPC Contact]] when replacing their [[ring of dueling]]. [[Stamina potion]]s or a [[revitalisation pool]] in the player's [[player-owned house|POH]] is also required.
